en.name: Barbecue sauce, bottled
en.summary: Bottled barbecue sauce is a shelf-stable commercial condiment built on tomato, vinegar, sugar and salt. Unopened it keeps about 1 year from purchase in the cupboard. After opening, the fridge gives it about 4 months — and the label's advice to refrigerate is about quality, not safety.
en.pantry: An unopened bottle keeps about 1 year from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard. The point most people get wrong is what happens after opening: a shelf-stable commercial barbecue sauce is safe stored at room temperature after opening, and quality, not safety, is the reason the label suggests refrigerating it. Refrigeration simply keeps a commercial sauce fresh for a longer period of time. Keep the bottle capped, out of sunlight and away from the hob either way.
en.fridge: The fridge is where an opened bottle keeps its colour, its sharpness and its aroma longest: about 4 months at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. Wipe the neck and the inside of the cap after pouring, because dried sauce around the thread is where mould gets a foothold. A homemade sauce or a bottle that has been thinned with stock or juice is a different product and belongs in the fridge from the start.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is given for bottled barbecue sauce, and there is little point freezing something that keeps for months in the fridge. If you have made a large quantity of a homemade version, freezing that in portions makes sense — but for a commercial bottle, the cupboard and the fridge already cover it. Freezing can also separate the emulsion, leaving a sauce you need to whisk back together.
spoilage: Mould around the neck, the cap thread or on the surface of the sauce
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell
A bottle that fizzes, hisses or squirts on opening after being stored
Colour gone dark brown and the texture separated into watery and thick layers
tips: Write the opening date on the label; months pass quickly on a condiment shelf.
Wipe the neck and cap after every pour.
Decant into a smaller bottle when it is nearly empty to cut down on air.
Never pour used marinade back into the bottle.

faq.q: Does barbecue sauce need to be refrigerated after opening?
faq.a: Not for safety — a shelf-stable commercial sauce is safe at room temperature after opening. Refrigeration keeps it fresher for longer, which is why the label suggests it.

faq.q: How long does barbecue sauce last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 4 months after opening at 4 °C or below.

faq.q: How long does an unopened bottle of barbecue sauce keep?
faq.a: About 1 year from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard.

faq.q: Can you reuse barbecue sauce that touched raw meat?
faq.a: Not without boiling it first. Sauce used as a marinade or brushed onto raw meat has to be boiled before it goes back on cooked food, and never returned to the bottle.

zh.name: 市售烤肉醬
zh.summary: 市售烤肉醬是以番茄、醋、糖和鹽為基底的常溫調味料。未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。開封後冷藏大約 4 個月——而瓶身建議冷藏，講的是品質而不是安全。
zh.pantry: 未開封的瓶子放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。多數人搞錯的是開封之後：常溫販售的市售烤肉醬，開封後放室溫仍然是安全的，標籤建議冷藏的理由是品質而不是安全。冷藏只是讓市售醬料的新鮮度維持得更久。不管放哪裡，都請蓋緊、避免日曬、遠離爐火。
zh.fridge: 冷藏是讓開封後的醬維持顏色、酸香和風味最久的地方：4 °C 以下大約 4 個月。每次倒完都擦一下瓶口和瓶蓋內側，因為螺紋上乾掉的醬垢正是發霉的起點。自製的醬，或是被高湯、果汁稀釋過的醬，是完全不同的東西，從一開始就該冷藏。
zh.freezer: 市售烤肉醬沒有提供冷凍期限，而且一個冷藏就能放好幾個月的東西，冷凍意義不大。如果是自製而且做了一大鍋，分裝冷凍才合理；市售瓶裝有櫥櫃和冰箱就夠了。冷凍還可能讓醬體分離，解凍後要再攪拌回去。
spoilage: 聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味
放過一陣子後，開瓶時冒氣、嘶聲或噴出來
顏色轉成深褐，質地分離成水層和稠層
tips: 在標籤上寫開封日期；調味料架上的時間過得很快。
每次倒完都擦瓶口和瓶蓋。
快用完時換小瓶裝，減少瓶內空氣。
刷過生肉的醬絕對不要倒回瓶子裡。

faq.q: 烤肉醬開封後一定要冰嗎？
faq.a: 以安全來說不用——常溫販售的市售烤肉醬開封後放室溫仍然安全。冷藏是為了讓它更久保持新鮮，所以標籤才會建議。

faq.q: 烤肉醬放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 開封後在 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 4 個月。

faq.q: 未開封的烤肉醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。

faq.q: 刷過生肉的烤肉醬還能再用嗎？
faq.a: 不先煮沸就不行。當醃醬或刷過生肉的醬，必須煮沸後才能再刷到熟食上，而且絕對不能倒回瓶子。
